title: Design an Experimentation Platform
interviewAnswer: An experimentation platform needs deterministic assignment, exposure logging, metric computation, statistical analysis, guardrails, metadata and trustworthy diagnostics such as SRM. Separate experiment execution from analysis so decisions are reproducible.
why: Design an Experimentation Platform appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
deepDive: An experimentation platform needs deterministic assignment, exposure logging, metric computation, statistical analysis, guardrails, metadata and trustworthy diagnostics such as SRM. Separate experiment execution from analysis so decisions are reproducible. Exposure/event logging. Metric/analysis service. Trust diagnostics and governance. A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
workedExample: Design a platform where product teams define variants, users are stably bucketed, events flow to an analysis pipeline, and results include power/guardrails/SRM.
commonMistakes: Applying the method without checking its assumptions or data-generating process.
Choosing it because it is familiar rather than comparing against an appropriate baseline.
followUps: What assumptions does Design an Experimentation Platform make?
How would you validate or debug Design an Experimentation Platform in practice?
production: In production, validate assumptions on real data, monitor the quantities that can drift, and keep a simple baseline so added complexity has a measurable reason to exist.
